newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake reaches creditor deal.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake reaches creditor deal.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp and its major trade creditors have agreed to allow the company to pay debts with a combination of returned inventory and stock, Reddi Brake said.
As part of the agreement, some of the returned inventory will be credited against the amount owed and some will be exchanged for high priority products.
The agreement is contingent upon new equity investment, which the company expects to announce within a week.
It also expects to complete agreements with its other creditors over the next several weeks.
The creditor agreement and other pending elements of the informal reorganization should provide up to $20 million in new equity to support the reorganization, it said.
